cards.question: What is the function of the nucleus?
cards.answer: It contains genetic material and controls the activities of the cell

cards.question: What is the function of the cell membrane?
cards.answer: It controls what enters and leaves the cell

cards.question: Where does aerobic respiration take place?
What is the function of ribosomes?
cards.answer: They are where protein synthesis takes place

cards.question: Name two structures found in plant cells but not animal cells.
cards.answer: Cell wall and chloroplasts (also a permanent vacuole)
